summary: Documentation only: ADR-0091 (Windows children keep their data outside the agent's folder) accepted by the operator after the node check on 2026-11-13; ADR index regenerated; the CHANGELOG row of the published release v0.33.0 gets its link and date and names ADR-0091 accepted. No code, configuration or version change.

findings.evidence: ADR-0091 was proposed in #143 (agent 0.34.1). Its confirmation asked for a node check: the children's data moved out of the agent's folder, Ollama back on LOCAL SERVICE.
findings.resolution: Node check on a Windows node with agent 0.34.1 (2026-11-13): Ollama, its home, the STT service's data and cache moved to the children's data folder, which the operator's move created with the agent's protected access list; Ollama runs as localservice, every access entry ok/granted with resolve ok and no move_to, the model list unchanged (8), a model loaded on the GPU and answered; the STT service healthy as localservice. One data folder (Strata's, owned by SYSTEM only) stays in the agent's folder for now and is still reported with move_to, as the ADR foresees.

tests.command: Node check on the Windows node: agent /health children[].access and Ollama /api/generate as LOCAL SERVICE
tests.evidence: ollama run_as localservice, healthy, access granted with resolve ok and no move_to; 8 models listed; qwen3.8 loaded (16.9 GB VRAM) and answered; stt localservice healthy, resolve ok.

limitations: Strata's data folder (SYSTEM only) is moved later as SYSTEM, together with the first check of Strata as LOCAL SERVICE.
